sloka: ज्येष्ठः केसरिणः पुत्रो वात आत्मज इति श्रुतः ।हनूमान् इति विख्यातो लन्घितो येन सागरः ॥६-२८-१०॥।।
transliteration: jyeṣṭhaḥ kesariṇaḥ putro vāta ātmaja iti śrutaḥ ।hanūmān iti vikhyāto langhito yena sāgaraḥ ॥6-28-10॥।।

translations.english: "He is the eldest son born of Kesari and the son of WindGod and is popularly known as Hanuman. He leapt over the sea and came."
